questions.question: What is the key characteristic of Link-State Routing?

answers.a: Each node maintains only its neighbor's information
answers.b: Each node has a complete view of the network topology
answers.c: Nodes share routing tables with only one neighbor
answers.d: Routes are updated using hop count only

questions.question: Which algorithm is used in Link-State Routing to compute the shortest path?
What type of packet is used in Link-State Routing to share network information?
What does a node do after receiving Link-State Packets (LSPs) from all other nodes?

answers.a: It forwards them to the destination host
answers.b: It reconstructs the entire network topology
answers.c: It immediately updates the forwarding table
answers.d: It sends the LSPs back to neighbors

questions.question: What happens after the Link-State algorithm terminates?

answers.a: Each node knows the complete least-cost path to all destinations
answers.b: Nodes must request updated routing information
answers.c: Only the shortest path to a single destination is known
